description: This file defines the DocumentVersion class, representing a specific version of a document within the receipt and expense management backend system. It includes fields for document metadata, storage information, processing results, and status tracking, and is mapped to a MongoDB collection.

classes.name: DocumentVersion
classes.description: Represents an immutable snapshot of a document version with associated processing data and metadata, stored in MongoDB.

methods.name: DocumentVersion
methods.description: Default constructor for creating an empty DocumentVersion instance.

methods.name: DocumentVersion
methods.description: Constructor for creating a new DocumentVersion with core metadata.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of this document version.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of this document version.

methods.name: getDocumentId
methods.description: Returns the reference ID of the parent document.

methods.name: setDocumentId
methods.description: Sets the reference ID of the parent document.

methods.name: getVersionNumber
methods.description: Returns the version number of this document version.

methods.name: setVersionNumber
methods.description: Sets the version number of this document version.

methods.name: getFileName
methods.description: Returns the original filename of the document.

methods.name: setFileName
methods.description: Sets the original filename of the document.

methods.name: getMimeType
methods.description: Returns the MIME type of the document.

methods.name: setMimeType
methods.description: Sets the MIME type of the document.

methods.name: getSizeBytes
methods.description: Returns the size of the document in bytes.

methods.name: setSizeBytes

methods.name: getOcrText

methods.name: setOcrText

methods.name: getExtractedFields

methods.name: setExtractedFields

methods.name: getStatus

methods.name: getErrorMessage
methods.description: Returns the error message if processing failed.

methods.name: setErrorMessage

methods.name: getCreatedAt

methods.name: setCreatedAt
